hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles the full swap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to settle accounting with the PoolManager. A custom curve invariant is verified after each trade. beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeDonate all revert to prevent unauthorized pool creation, CLAMM positions, and irrecoverable donations.
